name: StaffingRequestFulfilmentDesk
tagline: Fill every staffing request faster – match, soft book, approve and hard book in one app.
description: A complete staffing request app for professional-services firms: request queue, candidate matching with a transparent score, soft and hard bookings with approval rules, over-allocation clash detection, a fulfilment board, a demand timeline and a talent pool. Drop it on a canvas screen, a model-driven form or a Power Pages page and it works immediately in demo mode.
features: Weighted match score (skills, grade, availability, location)
Soft / hard booking with approval rules
At-risk requests starting soon with nobody booked
Bulk actions with confirmation and undo
Phone layout with bottom view bar
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform libraries, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: StaffingRequestFulfilmentDesk data-set + StaffingRequestFulfilmentDeskPortal field control for Power Pages)
